title: Mapping for a Lens

patient.name: Ms Tan Hui Xin
patient.presenting_complaint: Referred for corneal topography to help fit specialised contact lenses
patient.address: Blk 782 Ang Mo Kio Ave 3, #13-493, Singapore 101196

history.hpc: Ms Tan says 'My normal contact lens never fit well, the doctor want to map my cornea first.' She has high astigmatism and is being assessed for specialised contact lenses, for which topography of the corneal surface is needed.
history.pmhx: High astigmatism. Previous soft contact lens use. No previous eye surgery.
history.social_hx: Designer; wants contact lenses for work.

examination_findings.fundus: Not the focus of this station

corneal_topography.purpose: Map corneal curvature and shape to guide specialised contact lens fitting
corneal_topography.result: Regular astigmatic map obtained; values provided to the fitter
corneal_topography.quality: Good capture; lenses left out for the required washout period beforehand

diagnosis: Corneal topography is performed to guide specialised contact lens fitting, mapping the corneal curvature and shape after the required lens washout period. Good-quality maps are obtained and provided to the fitter/doctor. This is a procedural station; the OT does not select the lens.

immediate: Confirm identity and that both eyes are to be mapped
Confirm the contact lenses have been left out for the required washout period
Explain the non-contact scan and position the patient on the corneal apex
Capture good-quality curvature maps for both eyes, repeating poor captures
Provide the maps to the fitter/doctor for lens selection
Document the findings and capture quality
follow_up: Fitter/doctor to select the specialised lens using the maps
Re-map if recent lens wear affected the cornea
patient_education: Explain the scan maps the curvature of the cornea to fit the lens
Reassure it is quick and non-contact
Explain why lenses must be left out before mapping

key_points: Confirms identity and that both eyes are mapped
Confirms the required contact lens washout period
Aligns on the corneal apex and captures good-quality maps
Understands topography guides contact lens fitting
Knows recent lens wear distorts the map
Does not select the lens — provides maps to the fitter
Recognises the need for good-quality captures
Provides the maps to the fitter/doctor
Documents the findings and capture quality
Educates the patient on washout and the procedure
